messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — trends from the last 3 postmortems show a repeating authz pattern: token validation failures after rolling deploys AND missing audit records for service-account rotations. Want to assign owners & timelines so this stops recurring.

Alex Kim: I'm in. Can someone paste a representative log line or error we can use for the smoke test?

Maya Chen: Example we've been seeing:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: exp check failed, iss mismatch, request_id=abcd-1234
```

Jordan Patel: We also see a burst of `cache-miss` events on envoy immediately after deploys — suspect stale JWKs / key cache invalidation timing.

Sasha R.: Confirmed on audit side: `service-account:rotate` events were absent in two of the incidents (so rotations happened but no durable audit write). We need a stronger write+confirm step.

Leo Ortiz: Proposed minimal plan:
1) Deploy-time token smoke (post-deploy check that validates a signed token end-to-end).
2) Rotation flow: write audit event to secure-log with retry before committing rotation.
3) Runbook + automation for orphaned creds detection.
4) Trend dashboard + weekly alert on authz anomalies.
Who volunteers for ownership?

Maya Chen: Proposed owners & dates:
- Alex Kim — deploy-time token smoke script + CI gating (due 2026-04-01)
- Sasha R. — audit-write guarantee + retries + tests (due 2026-04-08)
- Jordan Patel — runbook + orphaned-creds sweep automation (due 2026-04-15)
- Leo Ortiz — authz trend dashboard + alerts (due 2026-03-29)
I'll add these to the action tracker after we ack.

Alex Kim: ack. I'll add a smoke script to infra/ci (simple curl + token validation) and open a PR linking the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/758

Sasha R.: ack. I'll insert a synchronous write+confirm step in the rotation flow and add retry logic for the secure-log write. Will include unit/integration tests. ETA ~1 week.

Jordan Patel: I'll draft the runbook section "Detecting and remediating orphaned creds" and propose a k8s job to sweep inactive tokens. Will open RFC by Friday.

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5691 assigned to Alex Kim, due 2026-04-01

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-5692 assigned to Sasha R., due 2026-04-08

Maya Chen: Also proposing a recurring 30-min monthly "authz retro" to look for patterns and unblock these owners. Who's in to attend?

Leo Ortiz: I'll host the dashboard and the first retro.

Alex Kim: I'll attend.

Jordan Patel: In.

Sasha R.: In.

Maya Chen: Great — I'll schedule the recurring and post the playbook link here: https://redwood.internal/docs/authz-triage-playbook

Maya Chen: One more operational note: if you can't meet your owner deadline, flag here 48h before so we can reassign or change scope. Thanks everyone :pray:
